strings.app.title: TFM2 Editor
strings.champion_mastery.active_info: Currently available in this save. Highlighted for quick identification.
strings.champion_mastery.help: Editing a value automatically checks that champion. Apply Selected saves only checked champions.
strings.champion_mastery.help.dev: Editing a value automatically checks that champion. Apply Selected writes only checked champions. ChampionProficiency.floor is left unchanged.
strings.champion_mastery.inactive_heading: Inactive / Not Yet Available in This Save
strings.champion_mastery.inactive_info: These champions are not currently available in this save, but their mastery values can still be edited.
strings.champion_mastery.inactive_info.dev: These champions already exist in the player's proficiency data but are not currently in the active save pool. They remain editable.

strings.compatibility.bridge_update.instruction: Update the Bridge through Steam Workshop, or download the matching release from GitHub for manual installation.
strings.compatibility.bridge_update.message:
The installed TFM2 Editor Bridge is older than the version required by this release.

Some features may not work correctly or could modify game data unexpectedly.
strings.compatibility.bridge_update.title: Bridge Update Required
strings.compatibility.critical.message:
This Bridge version is too old to be used safely with this version of TFM2 Editor.
The editor will now close.
strings.compatibility.critical.title: Compatibility Error
strings.compatibility.editor_update.instruction: Please download the latest matching version of TFM2 Editor from GitHub.
strings.compatibility.editor_update.message:
The installed TFM2 Editor Bridge is newer than the version supported by this Editor release.

This may be because Steam Workshop updated the Bridge automatically while the desktop editor remained unchanged.

Some features may not work correctly or could modify game data unexpectedly.
strings.compatibility.editor_update.title: Editor Update Required
strings.compatibility.not_supported.bridge_instr: Update TFM2 Editor Bridge before reconnecting.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.bridge_messa:
This combination of TFM2 Editor and TFM2 Editor Bridge is not supported.

The Bridge connection has been closed to protect your active career from incorrect or unsafe changes.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.editor_instr: Please download the required TFM2 Editor release from GitHub.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.editor_messa:
This combination of TFM2 Editor and TFM2 Editor Bridge is not supported.

The Bridge connection has been closed to protect your active career from incorrect or unsafe changes.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.generic_inst: Install a supported matching Editor and Bridge release before reconnecting.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.generic_mess:
This combination of TFM2 Editor and TFM2 Editor Bridge is not supported.

The Bridge connection has been closed to protect your active career from incorrect or unsafe changes.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.heading: NOT SUPPORTED
strings.compatibility.not_supported.protocol_mes:
This combination of TFM2 Editor and TFM2 Editor Bridge uses an unsupported protocol.

The Bridge connection has been closed to protect your active career from incorrect or unsafe changes.
strings.compatibility.not_supported.title: Compatibility Not Supported
strings.compatibility.status.command_blocked: Game-data commands are disabled because this Editor and Bridge combination is not supported.
strings.compatibility.status.connection_blocked: The Bridge connection has been closed because this Editor and Bridge combination is not supported.
strings.compatibility.warning.bridge_install: Installed Bridge: v{installed} → Install matching Bridge v{required}
strings.compatibility.warning.bridge_update: Installed Bridge: v{installed} → Update Bridge to v{required}
strings.compatibility.warning.download: Download the matching release from GitHub.
strings.compatibility.warning.game_target_messag:
The installed Bridge was built for a different Teamfight Manager 2 version.

Some features may not work correctly or could modify game data unexpectedly.
strings.compatibility.warning.game_versions: Supported TFM2: v{supported} | Bridge target: v{bridge_target}
strings.compatibility.warning.generic_instructio: Install the matching TFM2 Editor and Bridge release before making important changes.
strings.compatibility.warning.heading: WARNING!
strings.compatibility.warning.message:
This version of TFM2 Editor does not match the installed Bridge.
Some features may fail or modify data incorrectly.
strings.compatibility.warning.protocol_message:
This TFM2 Editor release does not support the protocol reported by the installed Bridge.

Some features may not work correctly or could modify game data unexpectedly.
strings.compatibility.warning.title: Compatibility Warning
strings.compatibility.warning.unverified_message:
This TFM2 Editor release could not fully verify the installed Bridge.

Some features may not work correctly or could modify game data unexpectedly.

strings.contract.mode.player.edit_active: Mode: Edit the current active contract.
strings.contract.mode.player.free_agent_create: Mode: Create an active contract for this free-agent player.
strings.contract.mode.player.free_agent_move: Mode: Create an active contract and move this free-agent player to the selected team.
strings.contract.mode.player.move_existing: Mode: Move the player and apply the edited active contract.
strings.contract.mode.player.select_team: Select a team before applying the contract.
strings.contract.mode.staff.edit_active: Mode: Edit the current active staff contract in place while preserving existing contract data.
strings.contract.mode.staff.free_agent_create: Mode: Create an active contract for this free-agent staff member.
strings.contract.mode.staff.free_agent_move: Mode: Create an active contract and move this free-agent staff member to the selected team.
strings.contract.mode.staff.move_existing: Mode: Move staff to another team and apply the edited active contract. Old recruitment requests are cleared when the team changes.
strings.contract.mode.staff.select_team: Select a team before applying the active contract.
strings.contract.reset_free_agent_help: Restore the automatic free-agent contract defaults and keep the selected destination team.
strings.contract.reset_live_help: Reload the current live contract values.
strings.contract.staff.direct_info: This edits the active staff contract directly.
strings.economy.heading: Economy
strings.economy.info: Edit your team's finances. Changes take effect after you select Apply.
strings.economy.info.dev: Edit the active team's economy using the same compact money format shown in TFM2. You can enter values such as $500K, $2.5M, or $1B.
strings.editor.recommended_save: Recommended: Save your career before making changes with the editor.
strings.editor.recommended_save_text: Save your career before making changes with the editor.
strings.lists.delete_confirmation: Delete '{name}'? This removes the local list file.
strings.lists.heading: Saved Lists
strings.lists.info: Create reusable player and staff shortlists. Lists are stored locally beside TFM2 Editor.
strings.lists.select_list: Select a saved list to view its contents.
strings.lists.status.not_found: The selected list could not be found.
strings.lists.status.select_to_open: Select a list to open in Search.
strings.lists.status.unsupported_format: This list file uses an unsupported format or version.
strings.player_communication.footer: Actual Communication is the value shown in the player profile. Pending XP is updated separately by TFM2's training progression.
strings.player_communication.heading: Communication Level
strings.player_communication.info: Edit the player’s current Communication Level for the selected region.
strings.player_communication.info.dev: Player Communication has two separate values in TFM2: the actual 0–100 proficiency used by the player profile, and pending training XP stored for weekly progression.
strings.player_communication.native_unresolved: Native region could not be resolved for this player.
strings.player_communication.no_actual_regions: No learned regions are stored for this player.
strings.player_communication.no_actual_value: No Communication value is stored for this region. Apply a value to add it, or apply 0 to remove it.
strings.player_communication.pending_xp_tooltip: Read-only progression processed by TFM2 during weekly training.
strings.player_editor.champion_mastery.heading: Champion Mastery
strings.player_editor.contract.edit_help: Open Edit Contract to adjust the active player contract.
strings.player_editor.contract.edit_scope: Edit Contract changes the active contract, bonuses, squad status, and transfer fee.
strings.player_editor.contract.finance_info: Money fields use TFM2-style amounts. Examples: $400K salary, $83.3 bonus, or $2.5M transfer fee.
strings.player_editor.contract.finance_info.dev: Money fields use TFM2-style amounts and are converted to the internal save values when applied.
strings.player_editor.contract.heading: Contract
strings.player_editor.heading: Player Editor
strings.player_editor.intro: Edit player name, attributes, positions, potential, active contracts, Champion Mastery, and Communication.
strings.player_editor.intro.dev: Edit player name, attributes, positions, potential, active contracts, Champion Mastery, and Communication.
strings.player_editor.positions.heading: Positions
strings.player_editor.positions.info: Up to three active positions are supported.
strings.player_editor.potential.heading: Potential
strings.player_editor.potential.info: Actual Potential is hidden in-game. The current and pending values are shown before you apply changes.
strings.player_editor.potential.info.dev: Actual Potential is the hidden 1–100 value. Grade presets set fixed values; editing the numeric value updates the grade automatically.
strings.rating.actual.fallback_dev_tooltip: Calculated fallback: the average of the 12 attributes.
strings.recruitment.heading: Transfers
strings.recruitment.info: Manage player and staff transfers, free agents, and negotiations for the active career.
strings.recruitment.instant_retry_tooltip: Removes the normal negotiation retry cooldown while enabled.
strings.recruitment.instant_retry_tooltip.dev: Moves negotiation retry cooldowns back to the request's last action date, allowing an immediate new offer after rejection.
strings.recruitment.player_management.create_con: Opens Edit Contract with automatic defaults. The player moves to the selected team only after the contract is applied.
strings.recruitment.player_management.heading: Player Management
strings.recruitment.player_management.info: Move contracted players, create contracts for free-agent signings, or set a contracted player to Free Agent.
strings.recruitment.player_management.info.dev: Move contracted players directly between teams, sign free agents through Edit Contract, or end a current contract to make the player a Free Agent.
strings.recruitment.player_management.move_toolt: Move the selected contracted player to the destination team.
Direct contract-team move. Clears pending transfer/recruit requests for that player. Test new game versions with a backup save first.
strings.recruitment.player_management.set_free_a: Ends the selected player's current contract and removes the player from the team roster.
This removes the active contract. Salary, transfer fee, contract dates, bonuses, and current contract requests will be cleared.
strings.recruitment.retry_mode_instant: Mode: Instant. Rejected negotiations can be retried immediately.
strings.recruitment.retry_mode_normal: Mode: Normal. The game controls negotiation retry cooldowns.
strings.recruitment.runtime_toggle.dev: Runtime toggle. Enabled state is re-applied automatically after loading another save.
strings.recruitment.search_staff_hint: Staff name, role, team, or ID
strings.recruitment.staff_management.create_cont: Opens Edit Contract with automatic defaults. The staff member moves to the selected team only after the contract is applied.
strings.recruitment.staff_management.info: Move contracted staff directly, or create an active contract before signing a free agent.
strings.recruitment.staff_management.move_toolti: Moves the active staff contract to the selected team. Contract terms can be edited separately.
strings.recruitment.staff_management.set_free_ag: Ends the selected staff member's current contract and removes the staff assignment.
This removes the active staff contract, salary, dates, and contract requests.
strings.recruitment.transfer_success_tooltip.dev: Forces the latest transfer and player-contract negotiation papers for your current team to Accepted during management ticks.
strings.search.advanced.info: Combine filters to narrow the player database. Saved filters are stored locally in the filters folder.
strings.search.advanced.info.dev: Import/Export uses normal files. Saved filters are stored in the local filters folder beside TFM2 Editor.exe. Enabled conditions combine with Quick Filters.
strings.search.advanced.saved_on_left: Saved filters are listed on the left.
strings.search.filter_name.label: Filter name
strings.search.intro: Search, filter, sort, and compare players, staff, teams, and saved lists.
strings.search.intro.dev: Database-style search for players, staff, teams, saved lists, and future historical snapshots.
strings.search.players.quick_filters_info: Fast filters for the full player database.
strings.search.players.rating_info: ≈ Actual Rating is the average of the 12 attributes. Potential Rating uses hidden Actual Potential.
strings.search.players.rating_info.dev: Actual Rating uses TFM2's rating when available; ≈ values are the average of the 12 attributes. Potential Rating is derived directly from hidden Actual Potential.
strings.search.players.table_help: Double-click a row to open Player Editor. Shift-click or drag to select multiple rows.
strings.search.players.table_help.dev: Click a header to sort. Double-click a player row to open Player Editor; right-click for the Open action. Hold Shift and click or drag across rows to select a range. Drag column separators to resize.
strings.search.staff.quick_filters_info: Fast filters for the full staff database.
strings.search.staff.saved_filters_info: Staff filters are stored separately from player filters.
strings.search.staff.table_help: Double-click a row to open Staff Editor. Shift-click or drag to select multiple rows.
strings.search.staff.table_help.dev: Click a header to sort. Double-click a staff row to open Staff Editor; right-click for the Open action. Hold Shift and click or drag across rows to select a range. Drag column separators to resize.
strings.search.teams.search_hint: Search team, manager, league, or ID...
strings.staff_editor.attributes.heading: Attributes
strings.staff_editor.attributes.info: Staff attributes use the same 1–100 edit range as player attributes.
strings.staff_editor.communication.heading: Communication
strings.staff_editor.communication.info: Edit the staff member’s current Communication Level for the selected region.
strings.staff_editor.communication.not_stored: No Communication value is stored for this region. Apply a value to add it, or apply 0 to remove it.
strings.staff_editor.contract.edit_help: Open Edit Contract to adjust the active staff contract.
strings.staff_editor.contract.edit_scope: Edit Contract changes the active staff contract.
strings.staff_editor.contract.finance_info: Salary uses TFM2-style amounts, such as $400K or $1.2M.
strings.staff_editor.heading: Staff Editor
strings.staff_editor.intro: Edit staff name, attributes, active contracts, salary, and Communication.
strings.staff_editor.no_data: No staff data loaded. Load a career and click Refresh Staff.
strings.staff_editor.potential_analysis_info: Potential Analysis measures how well this staff member evaluates player potential; it is not the staff member's own potential.
strings.status.label: Status: {status}
strings.team_champion_setup.empty: This team has no stored champion tiers or personal tactics.
strings.team_champion_setup.help: Read-only team tiers and personal tactic slots for champions currently stored on the selected Team record. Mod-added champions are included dynamically.
strings.team_competition.help: View upcoming matches, recent results, season records, and head-to-head statistics.
strings.team_competition.no_head_to_head: No completed official head-to-head records were found.
strings.team_competition.no_results: No completed global matches were found for this team.
strings.team_competition.no_upcoming: No directly resolved upcoming matches were found for this team.
strings.team_condition.bulk_hint: Enter Stamina, Condition, or both. Empty fields are left unchanged.
strings.team_condition.editor_help: Edit stamina and condition for the selected team's players. Values are applied only when you select Apply Changes.
strings.team_condition.no_bulk_value: Enter a Stamina or Condition value before using Set Selected.
strings.team_condition.no_changes: No Team Condition changes are pending.
strings.team_condition.no_members: No roster members are available for this team.
strings.team_condition.read_only: Read-only Development probe. Values are read from athlete.management.
strings.team_contract_center.no_players: No current roster players were found for this Team.
strings.team_contract_center.no_staff: No current staff members were found for this Team.
strings.team_contract_center.sort_note: Contracts are ordered by earliest contract end date.
strings.team_data_probe.help: Development-only raw Team record for field research. Editing this text does not write to the game.
strings.team_finance_center.budget_editor_help: Budget editing is available only for the player-controlled team.
strings.team_finance_center.fan_count_help: Matches the Fan Count shown in Team Info.
strings.team_finance_center.fan_expectation_help: Fan Expectation ranges from Bottom Tier to Top Tier.
strings.team_finance_center.help: Financial overview for the selected team.
strings.team_finance_center.popularity_help: Team Popularity Level. Natural team values range from 0 to 4.
strings.team_finance_center.read_only_ai: AI-team finances are read-only; payroll, budgets, gate income, and fan data remain available for inspection.
strings.team_gaming_house.help: Gaming House inventory and currently placed items.
strings.team_history.loading: Loading Team match and analysis data...
strings.team_history_summary.help: Summary of the team's match record, recent form, rating, and ranking.
strings.team_match_history.empty: No match history is available for this team.
strings.team_match_history.help: Completed matches for the selected team. Newest matches are shown first.
strings.team_merchandise.edit_help: Only Stock and Sell Price are editable for the player-controlled team.
strings.team_merchandise.empty: This team has no merchandise products.
strings.team_merchandise.help: View merchandise sales and edit Stock and Sell Price for the player-controlled team.
strings.team_move.contracted_player_note: Choose a destination team for this player.
strings.team_move.contracted_staff_note: Choose a destination team and staff role.
strings.team_move.free_agent_player_note: Free agents require a contract before joining a team.
strings.team_move.free_agent_staff_note: Free agents require a contract before joining a team.
strings.team_move.role_only_note: Choose a destination team and staff role.
strings.team_performance.champion_help: Champion performance for the selected team's current players. Picks are total player-champion appearances.
strings.team_performance.help: League performance statistics for the selected team's players and champions.
strings.team_performance.no_champion_stats: No champion performance statistics matched the current roster.
strings.team_performance.no_player_stats: No player statistics matched the current roster.
strings.team_performance.roster_note: If a player transferred during the season, their statistics may include matches played for their previous team.
strings.team_pre_match.empty: No pre-match analysis is available for this team.
strings.team_pre_match.help: Displays scouting reports created by your in-game scouts, including analyzed tactics, champion picks, and scouting insights. This information comes from in-game scouting, not TFM2 Editor.
strings.team_pre_match.no_champions: No champion picks are stored for this report.
strings.team_pre_match.no_insights: No detailed insights are stored for this report.
strings.team_pre_match.no_tactics: No analyzed tactics are stored for this report.
strings.team_recruitment.contracted_move_note: Contracted members can be moved directly to another team.
strings.team_recruitment.free_agent_contract_not: Free agents are signed through Edit Contract.
strings.team_recruitment.help: Move players and staff, or sign free agents, for the selected team.
strings.team_standings.empty: No standings entries are available for this competition.
strings.team_standings.help: Current league standings and team statistics.
strings.team_strategy.help: View and edit the selected team's strategy and Strategy Presets. AI-team strategy is read-only.
strings.team_strategy.probe_already_restored: Current and Last Strategy already match the original probe backup. The backup was cleared without writing again; if this happened after Proceed/refresh, authoritative persistence is not yet validated.
strings.team_strategy.probe_identical: Current and Last Strategy are identical, so this team cannot provide a visible swap verification right now.
strings.team_strategy.probe_restore_other_team: A Strategy probe backup is active for Team ID {team_id}. Return to that team and restore it before probing another team.
strings.team_strategy.probe_restored: Original Current/Last Strategy values restored and verified in the Editor/client snapshot.
strings.team_strategy.probe_select_team: Select a Team with loaded Strategy data first.
strings.team_strategy.probe_swapped: Probe swap verified in the Editor/client snapshot. Use Proceed, refresh Team Strategy, then Save/Load to validate authoritative persistence. Run Restore Original Strategy when finished.
strings.team_strategy.probe_verify_failed: Strategy probe response did not match the expected swapped/restored values. Do not continue to presets; refresh Team Strategy and inspect the save before further testing.
strings.team_strategy.safe_write_probe_help: Reversible probe only: swaps Current Strategy and Last Strategy in both client and authoritative server data. Run it again to restore the original values. Strategy Presets are not enabled yet.
strings.team_tactics.help: Analyze the team's historical strategies, results, and Strategy synergies from completed matches. This is historical analysis, not a prediction for the next opponent.
strings.team_tactics.historical_performance_help: Shows the historical results for each Strategy choice across completed matches and sets.
strings.team_tactics.historical_synergy_help: Explore Strategy combinations that appeared together in completed matches and compare their historical results.
strings.team_tactics.insufficient_no_linked: Historical own-Team replay Strategy is unavailable, and no stored Pre-Match Analysis report is linked to a completed match for additional scouting context.
strings.team_tactics.insufficient_own_strategy: Historical own-Team replay Strategy is unavailable for this selected Team. Scouting and roster information below remain separate context; Tactics Analysis does not invent historical Strategy evidence.
strings.team_tactics.linked_analyses: Analysis reports linked to completed matches
strings.team_tactics.linked_match_evidence_help: Shows completed Match IDs linked to stored Pre-Match Analysis reports. This is scouting-context evidence only; actual replay Strategy is the historical source of truth.
strings.team_tactics.no_correlations: No linked opponent-tactic outcome evidence is available for this Team.
strings.team_tactics.no_linked_match_evidence: No Pre-Match Analysis report is linked to a completed Match ID for this Team.
strings.team_tactics.opponent_outcomes_help: Each row joins a stored Pre-Match Analysis tactic to the completed match with the same Match ID. This remains separate scouting-context evidence and does not drive replay-derived Historical Performance or Synergy.
strings.team_tactics.roster_context_help: Shows the highest current Actual Rating available at each position plus stored MatchReport set-MVP evidence. This is current-roster context only and is not weighted in Historical Performance or Synergy.
strings.team_workspace.heading: Team
strings.team_workspace.intro: Review and manage the selected team.
strings.team_workspace.no_roster_members: No roster members found for this team.
strings.team_workspace.no_staff_members: No staff members found for this team.
strings.team_workspace.read_only: Manage team members, strategy, finances, transfers, and competition data.
strings.team_workspace.read_only_ai: Review team members, strategy, finances, transfers, and competition data. Some editing is unavailable for AI-controlled teams.
strings.team_workspace.search_hint: Type team name, manager, league, or ID...
strings.training.apply_not_confirmed: Training update was sent, but the authoritative roster state was not confirmed. Refresh and verify before continuing.
strings.training.apply_success_roster: Training XP multipliers updated for {count} roster players.
strings.training.full_roster_help: Set a future Training XP multiplier for each player on the current roster. Changes are written only when Apply Changes is used.
strings.training.full_roster_tooltip:
Sets the Training XP multiplier value for every player on your current roster.

Use Set All to copy this value to every player.
Changes are not written until Apply Changes is used.
strings.training.invalid_player_multiplier: Invalid Training XP multiplier for {player}: "{value}". Enter a multiplier of x1.0 or higher, with at most one decimal place.
strings.training.multiplier_representation_error: Training XP multiplier for {player}: "{value}" exceeds the safe integer representation supported by this Editor build.
strings.training.multiplier_tooltip:
Multiplies future Training XP gained by this player. x1.0 uses the game's normal Training XP gain.

Values above x5.0 are used at your own risk.
strings.training.only_validated: Training XP multipliers must be x1.0 or higher with at most one decimal place.
strings.training.player_team_only: Training controls are available for the player-controlled team only.
strings.training.roster_mismatch: Training roster changed. Refresh before applying changes.
strings.training.team_unavailable: Selected team is no longer available.
strings.training_xp_probe.empty: UI view cleared. Research state and full evidence log are unchanged. Press Refresh to show current status again.
strings.training_xp_probe.help: Development-only Training XP research. The UI auto-refreshes a bounded status/latest-event view while full evidence remains in the Bridge event log. Clear UI View pauses display auto-refresh until Refresh, Arm x2, or Disarm x2. The probe is read-only unless you explicitly arm the continuous x2 write probe below.
strings.training_xp_probe.window_title: Training XP Threshold / x2 Write Probe — {team}
strings.training_xp_probe.x2_warning: CONTINUOUS WRITE TEST: every positive core Training award for the selected player is doubled until Disarm x2 is pressed. Position XP, Communication/language, and Champion Mastery are untouched. Server lifecycle restart clears x2 for save safety.
